g.text: Can the score detect smaller changes?

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526171

g.text: Each method uses a separate stable-sample cutoff targeting a 5% false-alarm rate.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #263443

g.text: Fresh stable false-alarm rates: 4.71%–4.72%. Higher power is better at comparable false-alarm rates.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607181

g.text: Curves average positive and negative changes, then five replications. Dashed line marks 80% detection.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607181

g.text: All methods use stable acquisition pairs. Oracle likelihood knows which training tracts changed and their covariance shape.
